— 01
Area A

Pipeline Builder
& Integrations

From a static list to a visual canvas.

The original builder was a static module list with no visual flow. Replaced it with a node-based drag-and-drop canvas so teams can construct complex AI pipelines visually. Added Project → Pipeline → Builder hierarchy and module-specific panels: docs for RAG, security scores for security modules, per-module config.

BeforeStatic module list
AfterNode-based canvas
— 02
Area B

Module
Icon Design

Purpose without a label.

Generic web icons fail to communicate what each AI module does. Designed a custom icon set where each icon conveys its purpose at a glance — no label needed. Followed AWS's color-coding convention so familiar categories reduce friction instantly.

Custom module icons — purpose-driven, AWS color convention
— 03
Area C

Documents, Config
& Security Panels

Every module gets its own surface.

Each module type needed a dedicated configuration surface inside the builder. Built three integrated panels: a document manager for RAG knowledge bases, a per-module config panel for LLM settings and toggles, and a security scoring panel for threshold values per pipeline.

01Documents panel
02Module config
03Security scores
— 04
Area D

IAM & User
Management

Role-based access for a growing team.

As internal users grew, the platform needed a proper identity and access management layer. Built the user management panel supporting Super Admin and Member roles, with invite flows, searchable member lists, and pipeline-scoped access controls.

User ManagementRoles, invite flows, pipeline-scoped access
— 05
Area E

Chatbot
Redesign

Users now see what's running.

The chatbot had spacing inconsistencies and gave no real-time feedback while the backend processed. Redesigned the layout and added live module-by-module status updates so users see exactly what's executing.

BeforeNo processing updates, spacing issues
AfterLive module updates, refined layout
— 06
Section 02

Analytics &
Dashboard Ecosystem

Built in-house — why pay for what you can build?

With internal users onboarded, the team needed visibility into usage, security, and spend. Built six dashboards in-house — the product isn't yet profitable enough to justify a third-party service. Covers Cost & FinOps, Security & Compliance, Adoption & Users, Pipelines & Performance, and Executive Overview, plus a standalone Risk Scoring dashboard. Backed by Zustand and live API integration.

Client Work —
Unleashed Brands

Context
The WorldLink AI Layer chatbot code originated from the Unleashed Brands codebase — meaning the same React antipattern was inherited from there and still exists in UB's chatbot. The fix requires intensive refactoring to establish predictable component state.
